During August, AirPods Pro 3 are discounted by $50, AirPods Max 2 by $100, and AirTag 2 historic low price deals continue. However, today's top story in 9to5Toys' "Midday Quick Hits" is the M5 MacBook Air—we spotted the 24GB/512GB model discounted by $200, and also noticed Apple's official certified refurbished store has multiple configurations discounted by up to $300, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more details here). Additionally, there are various Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations saving close to $100, brand new black Beats 240W braided USB-C cables at $18, and a chance to pick up transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $40. All details below.

Apple refurbished store launches M5 MacBook Air historic lowest price, discounted up to $300

Although the retail prices of the latest MacBook series have been raised, and we have tracked deals up to $500, Apple's official certified refurbished store now offers the best prices ever for some M5 MacBook Air configurations. We always recommend picking up the base model at the lowest price from reputable sources, and now you can also get the 24GB 15-inch model with $300 off the new retail price, available in Midnight Black, Silver, Starlight and Sky Blue.

Apple's refurbished store is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 1TB storage for $1,699, with free shipping. As mentioned above, this deal covers all four colors: Midnight Black, Silver, Starlight and Sky Blue.

This MacBook Air has a new retail price of $1,900, while Amazon currently sells all configurations for over $1,999.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (original price $1,299) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (original price $1,599) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (original price $1,999) — $300 off

Today's deals at the Apple refurbished store bring this machine's price back to its previous pricing level, the biggest discount we've tracked since the price increase. Considering current market conditions, these official new prices are likely to hold through the end of the year, or even longer. So while this isn't the all-time lowest price, for anyone looking to get an M5 MacBook Air series this year, this is a very solid money-saving opportunity—we expect to wait until mid-2027 or later when the next generation MacBook Air launches before we see this price point again.

To browse all MacBook deals at the Apple refurbished store, click here—use the filters on the left side of the page to select the model you're looking for.

Historic low price: 15-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air discounted by $200 today

Ongoing: 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro discounted by $500 on Amazon today

MacBook prices have just been raised, but Amazon still offers up to $500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB/2TB this morning. The price is close to the best price we tracked before the price increase. More details below.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage for $2,499, with free shipping.

Considering this machine's original price is $2,999 at Apple and other channels, this is indeed a $500 discount. The deal applies to both Space Black and Silver models.

This is the best M5 Pro deal we've tracked since the price increase took effect.

Amazon's previous best discount on this machine was $300, now an additional $200 off.

Although this price doesn't quite reach the lowest price we tracked before the price increase, that's not something we can control—prices simply cannot go back to how they were. Considering the price increase that took effect about a month ago, this deal is only $100 higher than the M5 Pro's all-time lowest price.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models discounted by nearly $100 on Amazon

Update: As expected, Amazon has now also lowered prices on several other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural Titanium case with Anchor Blue Ocean Band, discounted by nearly $100. Details below.

While Series 11 deals have been steady, as we're seeing now in early August, Apple Watch Ultra 3 discounts are rarer. However, this morning we spotted Amazon offering nearly $100 off the black Ultra 3 with Black Unity Sport Band.

Amazon is now selling the black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band for $699.99, with free shipping.

The original price is $799, so this represents nearly $100 off, the best new unit deal we've found from a reputable retailer.

Aside from the brief $150 discount during Amazon Prime Day, this is one of the best prices of the year, and one of the few significant discounts we've tracked on Amazon.

At the time of writing, the black with Ocean Band is the only configuration with a significant discount. But if this discount follows the pattern from last time, we expect other color configurations to be discounted throughout today and the week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band $700 (original price $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (original price $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $700 (original price $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (original price $899)

If you want to get the Series 11, you can now buy it for much less:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

Brand new black Beats 240W braided USB-C cable drops to historic low price of $18, free shipping for Prime members (40% off)

Chance to pick up transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41

The Solo Buds' built-in battery life is surprisingly impressive—they are now the most affordable wireless earbuds in the Beats lineup. But with an MSRP of $80, Amazon's regular price of $70, and Best Buy's $41 with free shipping, the appeal is even greater. Browse all Beats deals at Best Buy here, more Solo Buds deals below.

Best Buy is now selling unboxed transparent red Beats Solo Buds in "excellent" condition for $40.99, with free shipping. About half the MSRP, lower than Amazon's $70 new unit price.

  • Fully functional, like new appearance.
  • All accessories included. Packaging may vary, may not include original packaging.

Of course, you could call them entry-level earbuds, but for $41, we're talking about fashionable earbuds from the Apple Beats brand.

As mentioned above, our testing shows these earbuds can provide up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge. Although they don't feature a wireless charging case, for most users, 18 hours of battery life at $41 is quite sufficient. Other features include one-tap seamless pairing, custom microphones with an "advanced noise-canceling learning algorithm" for superior call quality, and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
